+import os

+import requests

+

+import json
+import os
+from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
+
+
+def exchange_authorization_code(authorization_code: str, redirect_uri: str) -> dict:
+    client_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"]
+    client_secret = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET"]
+    payload = {
+        "code": authorization_code,
+        "client_id": client_id,
+        "client_secret": client_secret,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL, data=payload, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def handle_callback(callback_url: str, redirect_uri: str) -> dict:
+    query = parse_qs(urlparse(callback_url).query)
+    code = query.get("code", [None])[0]
+    if not code:
+        raise ValueError("missing authorization code")
+    return exchange_authorization_code(code, redirect_uri)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    callback_url = os.environ["CALLBACK_URL"]
+    redirect_uri = os.environ["REDIRECT_URI"]
+    tokens = handle_callback(callback_url, redirect_uri)
+    print(json.dumps(tokens))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: start_oauth_login.py
+import os
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+import webbrowser
+
+
+AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
+AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
+AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8080/callback")
+AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
+AUTH0_SCOPE = os.environ.get("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")
+
+
+def build_authorization_url() -> str:
+    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN or not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
+        raise RuntimeError("AUTH0_DOMAIN and AUTH0_CLIENT_ID are required")
+
+    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
+    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
+    params = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
+        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
+        "scope": AUTH0_SCOPE,
+        "state": state,
+        "nonce": nonce,
+    }
+    if AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
+        params["audience"] = AUTH0_AUDIENCE
+
+    query = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
+    return f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?{query}"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    url = build_authorization_url()
+    print(url)
+    webbrowser.open(url)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
